thread_text:
Maya D: Quick sync — propose a narrow launch slice for private deployments: customer egress presets + preflight validation + canary upgrade lane. Keep phase 1 CLI/installer-only.

Samir K: Sounds good. Limit presets to 3: nat-relay, bgp-peer, preserve-egress-ip. Covers field without too many permutations.

Elaine R: Add managed-nat for locked-down customers. Note: preserve-egress-ip requires explicit IP allocation and routing confirmation from customer netops.

Maya D: Proposed installer flags (minimal): --egress-mode=nat-relay|bgp-peer|preserve, --preserve-egress-ip=203.0.113.8/32, --bgp-asn=65020, --upgrade-canary=0.1, --egress-validate-only. Default nat-relay.

Samir K: Upgrade flow: canary subset -> smoke tests -> drain -> ramp. Example CLI: `operator upgrade --canary 10% --drain 120s --rollback-on-fail`. Smoke checks: HTTPS e2e, egress IP match, control-plane handshake.

Elaine R: Validation must check IP routability, prefix overlap, and BGP origin ASN. If validation fails, installer should return clear codes like EGRESS_IP_IN_USE or BGP_NOT_ACCEPTED.

Maya D: Launch gates: docs + runbook, two pilot customers verified (PilotA & PilotB) on nat & preserve flows, staging canary with rollback tested, telemetry (egress_validation.status + upgrade.outcome), and security signoff for KMS/HSM where needed.

Samir K: I'll add a small test harness that runs smoke steps and emits pass/fail. Also add --force-rollback. ETA 2 sprints for pilot.

Elaine R: I'll draft onboarding checklist capturing ASN, allowed prefixes, peering contact window, and emergency rollback contact. Include troubleshooting FAQ for NAT/firewall issues.

Maya D: infra-bot, please create follow-up ticket for egress preflight validator + smoke harness.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-14388: "egress preflight validator + smoke harness" assigned to @Samir K and @Elaine R, due EOW.

deploy-bot: Staging dry-run scheduled: 2024-05-03T03:00:00Z.

Maya D: Great. Keep scope tight — no console mapping in phase 1. We'll expand after pilot success.
